learning_outcomes.text: Students master and can apply the following mathematical methods for solving engineering problems: ordinary differential equations, partial differential equations.

syllabus_topics: Solution by substitution, Bernoulli-ODE, Riccati-ODE, Exact ODE, integrating factor

Recall: properties, Wronskian determinant, variation of constants, reduction of order, Euler-ODE, power series approach and generalized power series approach (2nd order), Linear boundary value problems
Definition, conversion of n-th order -> system, solution of the homogeneous problem, Wronskian determinant, variation of constants, approaches
Definition, classification, normal forms, heat equation, wave equation, d’Alembert’s method, Poisson equation / Dirichlet problem, Laplace transformation and pDGL, Fourier transformation and pDGL
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam. The grade contributes 6/138 to the final grade.
